subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should maintainers require proof and land this broader branch, or land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 and track the update-check parser normalization separately?
rationale: Both branches address the destructive state transition, but only this branch includes the sibling parser fix while only the competing branch currently has convincing real non-bundled CLI proof.

options.title: Prove and land this branch
options.body: Require inspectable exact-head non-bundled plugin proof, refresh against current main, then use this branch as the single fix for both reported npm 12 failure surfaces.

options.title: Land the narrower competitor
options.body: Use the proof-positive competing branch for state preservation and open a separate focused change for update-check singleton-array normalization.

recommendation.title: Prove and land this branch
recommendation.body: Require inspectable exact-head non-bundled plugin proof, refresh against current main, then use this branch as the single fix for both reported npm 12 failure surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both the update-check parser and the plugin update failure policy whose semantics require confirmation.
